brief_summary: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of Dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist pretreatment on reproductive outcomes in obese women before frozen embryo transfer.
brief_title: Dual GIP/GLP-1 Receptor Agonist in Obese Women Before Frozen Embryo Transfer

official_title: Dual Glucose-dependent Insulinotropic Peptide (GIP) and Glucagon-like Peptide-1 (GLP-1) Receptor Agonist in Women With Obesity for Frozen Embryo Transfer (FET): Pragmatic, Multicenter, Randomized Controlled Trial
